physicalNotes: Radius 1.515 Jupiter radii from Zhang et al. 2022 (2022A&A...666A..47Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...666A..47Z/abstract): 108,310.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
